name: @coo-quack/openclaw-cursor-cli
description: Run Cursor's cursor-agent CLI as an OpenClaw text inference backend

scripts.//test: One level only, on purpose: a nested directory under test/ is a suite of its own and needs its own script, or it silently drops out of the unit run. test/integration/ is the one that exists today.
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm test
scripts.//test:integration:docker: CI runs this same script, so the two cannot drift. The checkout is mounted read-only at /src and copied into a container-local /work by the entrypoint: the container installs its own linux binaries and can never write back into the workspace. No --user override — the image runs as its own non-root user.
scripts.test:integration:docker: docker build -f docker/integration.Dockerfile -t openclaw-cursor-cli-integration:local . && docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/src:ro openclaw-cursor-cli-integration:local
